History of Present Illness:
42-year-old woman. Twenty-four hours of right flank and lower abdominal pain with nausea. No urinary frequency, hematuria or vaginal symptoms.

Physical Examination:
Right lateral abdominal tenderness; pain with passive extension of the right hip. Temperature 38.3 C; heart rate 106/min; BP 134/70 mmHg; respiratory rate 18/min; SpO2 98% on room air.

Laboratory Tests:
WBC: 15.1 10^9/L (reference 4.0-11.0)
Hemoglobin: 13.1 g/dL (reference 12.0-17.5)
Platelets: 241 10^9/L (reference 150-400)
Sodium: 136 mmol/L (reference 135-145)
Potassium: 3.7 mmol/L (reference 3.5-5.0)
Creatinine: 1.1 mg/dL (reference 0.6-1.3)
CRP: 72 mg/L (reference <5)
Lipase: 35 U/L (reference 13-60)
ALT: 31 U/L (reference 7-45)
AST: 28 U/L (reference 10-40)
Alkaline phosphatase: 91 U/L (reference 40-130)
Total bilirubin: 0.7 mg/dL (reference 0.2-1.2)
Serum pregnancy test: negative (reference negative)
Urinalysis: Negative leukocyte esterase and nitrite; 0-2 WBC/hpf; 0-2 RBC/hpf

Imaging Findings:
CT abdomen/pelvis: retrocecal appendix measures 11 mm with adjacent fat stranding. Kidneys enhance normally; no ureteric stone.
